text:
emily.marketing: kicked off a quick sync on pricing page experiments. two asks: 1) finalise tier labels for the new page, 2) plan A/B for the new calculator + sales routing.

sam.product: current options from copy review: (A) Pay-as-you-go / Committed / Enterprise, (B) Flex / Committed / Enterprise, (C) Starter / Growth / Enterprise. my vote = B (Flex feels modern).

nate.analytics: naming affects funnel — we saw 'Starter' lower perceived capability in previous tests. measurable difference ~0.6pp. recommend testing Flex vs Starter in the AB.

emily.marketing: agree on testing. i'll write microcopy variations for the plan bullets. we should also surface 'latency SLA' on Committed tier callout.

maya.cs: can we add an FAQ anchor for "How does committed capacity affect latency?" so CS can deep-link. also, please ensure calc CTA routes to sales with a tag so we know which tier page produced the lead.

sam.product: for the calculator A/B: Variant A = simple estimator (single input form), Variant B = tiered slab calculator (commit slider + tier preview). We need to capture variant in the sales lead payload.

ryan.growth: required lead payload fields: source=pricing_page, experiment=tier_calc_nov, variant=(simple|slab), tier_selected=(flex|committed|enterprise). also add utm param utm_campaign=pricing_tier_test when linking to webinar.

nate.analytics: events we'll emit: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_shown, calc_submit, contact_sales_click. plan to track 14d MQL_rate and demo_sched_rate. baseline simple estimator conversion = 3.9%. target slab >= 4.5%.

emily.marketing: also want to push a small benchmark narrative for the launch blog: "How pricing choices change unit economics at scale" — will draft in GH. link to calc for readers.

sam.product: FYI frontend will add hidden fields to sales form. payload example: 
```json
{"lead_origin":"pricing_page","experiment":"tier_calc_nov","variant":"slab","tier_selected":"committed"}
```
make sure Sales CRM maps these to Lead Source and Campaign fields.

maya.cs: Sales routing ask: route calculator leads with tier_selected=committed to enterprise AE queue if monthly_estimate >= 100k tokens. Otherwise route to SDR. helps reduce handoffs.

ryan.growth: for webinar CTA underneath calculator: show an interstitial capturing email + short use-case dropdown (e.g., POC, production, eval). we'll retarget attendees and non-attendees separately.

nate.analytics: small bug note — decimal rounding in slab calc for token_price leads to 0.00 when average tokens per message < 0.01. please guard division by zero and format to 4 decimal places for calc preview.

sam.product: filed ENGINEERING ticket ENG-1934 for rounding/formatting and form mapping. assigned to @frontend-team. P1 for accuracy.

emily.marketing: timeline proposal: finish copy + hidden field mapping Thu, ENG fixes Fri, QA Sat, flip A/B Mon 09:00 PT, run 14 days. objections?

ryan.growth: sounds good. request: add utm_experiment param to webinar link and to contact-sales CTA so we can stitch sessions in GA.

maya.cs: CS playbook update queued. include snippet: "If a customer asks about latency vs commit, link to /pricing#latency-sla and note committed capacity improves SLA windows."

nate.analytics: i'll build the dashboard tile and set alerts for delta >= 0.4pp on conversion. will need final event names by EOD Thu.

sam.product: confirming event names: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_exposed, calc_submit, contact_sales_click, webinar_interstitial_submit. sending spec to analytics.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-page v2.0 — triggered by emily.marketing (CI #4999) :rocket:

emily.marketing: action items recap: 1) draft copy variations (emily) 2) ENG ticket ENG-1934 rounding + form fields (sam) 3) dashboard + baselines (nate) 4) CS FAQ anchor + playbook (maya) 5) webinar interstitial UX + utm params (ryan). will update experiment brief and post in #growth when we flip the test.

emily.marketing: thanks team, i'll drop the brief into the drive and tag people on the checklist.
